How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
15:10
Lucy
•
AI Agent

That’s such a great question! To get the absolute best out of your Abbott Lyon jewellery, here are a few easy tips:

Put your jewellery on last, after applying any lotions, perfumes, or hair products—this helps protect the finish and keeps it looking shiny.
Avoid wearing your jewellery in the shower, pool, or while exercising, as water and sweat can affect the plating over time.
Store your pieces in their original Abbott Lyon box or a soft pouch when you’re not wearing them, to prevent scratches and tangling.
Give your jewellery a gentle wipe with a soft cloth every now and then to keep it sparkling and remove any oils or residue.

With a little care, your beautiful piece will stay looking fabulous for ages! If you want more specific care tips for a certain type of jewellery, just let me know. I’m so excited for you to enjoy your new piece! 🧡
